breakpoint_semantics: Select the linear EOTF segment exactly when encoded_code/65535 <= 809/20000 by comparing encoded_code*20000 <= 809*65535 with integers; codes 0 through 2650 are linear and 2651 through 65535 are nonlinear.
excluded_responsibilities: Document schemas and validation, keyframe interpolation, image buffers, Surface allocation, compositing, rasterization, ICC/HDR/tone mapping, gamut conversion, resize, encoding, persistence and publication are outside this scalar paint profile.
failure_semantics: Every RGBA16Input bit pattern is valid and conversion returns one complete Pixel by value. There is no partial result, allocation budget, I/O or external fallback.
input_alpha: Alpha is an independent linear uint16 straight-alpha value and is copied exactly to output A. Hidden RGB under alpha zero is accepted but output is exact transparent black.
input_colorimetry: RGB uses BT.709/sRGB primaries, D65 white, the exact sRGB transfer function and full range.
input_semantics: One scalar RGBA16Input paint with unpremultiplied RGB encoded across the complete uint16 sRGB code range. It is not an image, row buffer, Surface or document-model type.
linear_segment: For a linear-segment code c, the final unpremultiplied linear uint16 value is the nearest-even integer to 25*c/323, derived exactly from (c/65535)/12.92*65535 with 12.92=323/25.
nonlinear_segment: For a nonlinear code c, evaluate 65535*(((c/65535)+11/200)/(211/200))^(12/5). Select the final uint16 directly with exact big-integer threshold comparisons after raising positive sides to the fifth power; no root approximation or intermediate linear quantization is used.
operation_bounds: Each scalar conversion performs at most three nonlinear conversions. Each nonlinear conversion uses one exact fixed-size preparation and exactly 16 binary threshold decisions over uint16 output; every persistent big.Int operand and result is non-negative and at most 290 bits. All big.Int state is function-local and no process-wide mutable lookup or cache exists.
premultiplication: After EOTF quantization, compute each RGB channel times the original linear alpha divided by 65535 and round the complete exact rational once to nearest-even. Alpha remains unchanged; alpha zero produces 0,0,0,0.
transfer_quantization: Round the complete exact EOTF result once to the nearest uint16; an exact half chooses the even integer. Float, pow, platform color APIs, dithering, clamps and host-dependent approximations are forbidden.
transfer_table_serialization: For conformance only, evaluate all 65536 encoded codes in ascending order and serialize each resulting unpremultiplied linear uint16 as unsigned big-endian with no header. Runtime does not retain this table.
